amendments.reason: Identity Access owns the mobile push device registration because it owns the mobile session the registration is bound to: one stable row per app install keyed by the verified session's device id, with the provider token, a session binding that names the session by the random instance id the server minted when it was issued, and a barrier of the sessions whose logout this device has completed, each entry carrying its own expiry so logout prunes the ones that can no longer be presented. It stores nothing derived from the mobile password, so a database copy cannot verify password guesses offline; rotating MOBILE_ACCESS_PASS must therefore also advance MOBILE_SESSION_REVOCATION_EPOCH. It is pending source state, intentionally not asserted as deployed production inventory, and grants no authorization to anyone.
